dish: catch-your-own live squid, sliced to ika-sōmen sashimi on the spot
n: Hakodate Asaichi Ekini Ichiba (函館朝市 えきに市場)
address: Hakodate Morning Market, by JR Hakodate Station, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The Morning Market hall with the squid-fishing tank — hook a live squid and the stallholder slices it into translucent sashimi with ginger soy at the table.

dish: Hakodate seafood and crab to eat or ship
n: Hakodate Kaisen Ichiba Honten (はこだて海鮮市場 本店)
w: A big Bay-area seafood market of crab, squid and roe for tasting and shipping home.
